about.hero_tagline: Write your book, typeset it properly, export it
about.hero_body: Book Studio is an open-source Laravel application for authoring a book as chapters, giving it real typography, and exporting a print-ready PDF that renders Arabic the way it should be rendered — including the English words inside it.
about.why_body: Writing tools handle Arabic badly. Word processors fight you over direction and font pairing, and the moment an English term appears inside an Arabic paragraph — or an Arabic quotation inside an English one — the typography breaks. I wanted a tool that treats Arabic as a first-class script rather than an afterthought, so I built one.
about.feature_authoring_body: Write a book as ordered chapters, reorder them by drag-and-drop, and keep your whole library on one dashboard.
about.feature_typography_body: Four book templates, paired Latin and Arabic fonts, text direction, sizes, line height, and toggles for the cover, contents, chapter headers, and page numbers.
about.feature_arabic_body: Seven Arabic book faces alongside seven Latin serifs, with correct shaping and direction — and opposite-script runs detected by Unicode range and rendered in their own family.
about.feature_export_body: Every book exports through mpdf with a cover page, a generated clickable table of contents, chapter headers, and page numbers.
about.feature_ocr_body: Upload a photo or scan of a printed or handwritten page and pull its text straight into a chapter instead of retyping it.
about.feature_api_body: Every feature is a documented REST endpoint behind Sanctum, so one backend serves the browser and any future mobile client.
about.stack_auth_value: Sanctum (session and token), Google sign-in, OTP email verification
about.stack_i18n_value: English, Arabic, French — with full RTL support
about.stack_quality_value: Pest feature tests, OpenAPI docs via Scramble, CI on GitHub Actions
about.note_auth: OTP codes for email verification and password reset instead of signed URLs, because the same flow has to work for a cookie-authenticated browser session and a token-authenticated API client alike.
about.note_settings: Book layout settings are enum-backed casts, so invalid typography is rejected at the model boundary instead of surfacing later as a broken PDF.
about.note_authz: Ownership policies plus a single admin gate rather than a roles-and-permissions package — the app has two authorization shapes, and a package would add configuration surface without covering a case they miss.
about.note_frontend: Blade with Alpine instead of a full SPA framework: forms, drag-and-drop, and a settings panel need neither client-side routing nor a virtual DOM.
about.author_body_intro: I'm Hiba Sabouh, a backend developer working mostly in Laravel. Most of my work is on systems where the hard part isn't the screens — multi-tenant platforms, payment reconciliation, document workflows — the ones that have to stay correct while real money and real operations move through them.
about.author_body_project: Book Studio is a personal project, built solo from an empty Laravel application: schema, REST API, Blade and Alpine frontend, PDF rendering pipeline, and admin back-office. It's open source under the MIT license — the code is on GitHub, and issues and pull requests are welcome.
about.roadmap_body: The project is still growing. Next on the list:
about.roadmap_content: Rich text inside chapters — bold, italic, and colour
about.roadmap_grammar: Grammar and spelling suggestions, accepted one at a time from an inline diff
about.roadmap_export: Queued PDF export with status polling and a completion notification
about.roadmap_sharing: Public read-only sharing links, and full-text search across books and chapters
about.cta_body: Bug reports, feature suggestions, and pull requests are all welcome.
